name: Pre-SG18 / Pre-SG21 temporal and head-role diagnostics
gt_use: event labels and analysis only; no mask, method, cutoff, or class tuning
observation_normalization: independent minmax at 64x64, bilinear at annotation size, threshold 0.45
structure: exact 64x64 attention affinity; Euclidean pixel distance; local radii inclusive; reciprocity=sum min(A_ij,A_ji)/sum A_ij
stage_definition: mean z over all calls and heads in fixed stage, each stage scored against CA
call_definition: mean z across eight heads within call, each call scored against CA
